is_anopheles.evidence: Page 1: 'Monitoring the operational impact of insecticide usage for malaria control on Anopheles funestus from Mozambique'

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper only discusses WHO bioassay susceptibility test results and mentions kdr historically in the text; no molecular marker genotyping was performed or reported in this paper.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No molecular marker genotype counts or frequencies are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: Page 1: 'WHO susceptibility test results on 1–3 day old F1 An. funestus from 16 localities in Mozambique'

is_primary_study.evidence: This publication is a formal Correction notice (erratum) for Casimiro et al. 2007 (Malaria J 2007, 6:142).

sub_country_location.evidence: Page 2, Table 1 lists 16 specific localities in Mozambique including Benfica, Boane, Catuane, Chibuto, Chokwe, Mafambisse, etc.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Page 2, Table 1 reports 1999 baseline data and 2006 data.

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is an erratum/correction notice for a previously published study (Casimiro et al., Malaria J 2007, 6:142).

supplement.evidence: No target marker data exists in supplementary files for this correction.

assessment.summary: This document is a formal correction notice for Casimiro et al. (2007) providing corrected WHO susceptibility bioassay data (Lambda-cyhalothrin, Deltamethrin, Bendiocarb, DDT) for Anopheles funestus across 16 localities in Mozambique. It does not report any molecular target marker genotyping data.
exclusion_reasons: Does not report target marker genotyping data
